title: 神経科学
subtitle: Neuroscience
educationalGoal: This course is intended for Brain Science majors. The goal of this course is to introduce students to the study of neuroscience. Students will learn fundamental information about cellular biology and the electrophysiological properties of neurons, neuroanatomy, psychopharmacology, and how the activity of neurons can yield sensory perception, motor control, and complex behavioral functions such as learning and motivation.
advice: The course will provide information that should enable the student to explain: 1. Neuron structure and function (dendrites, axon, cell body, synapse). 2. Information processing by the nervous system (sensory input, motor output). 3. Formation of resting potential (ion channels, sodium-potassium pump). 4. Modeling of resting potential (equilibrium potential, Nernst equation). 5. Monitoring neural activity (intracellular recording, extracellular recording). 6. Generation of action potential (hyperpolarization, depolarization, voltage-gated ion channel). 7. Conduction of action potential (saltatory conduction). 8. Synaptic transmission (chemical synapse, synaptic vesicle, neurotransmitter, ligand-gated ion channel). 9. Generation of postsynaptic potential (EPSP, IPSP). 10. Neurotransmitters (acetylcholine, biogenic amines, amino acids, neuropeptides). 11. Sensory reception and transduction (sensory receptor, coding of stimulus intensity). 12. Mechanism of human vision (retina, rod, cone, rhodopsin, color vision, visual field). 13. Mechanism of hearing, equilibrium, smell and taste (mechanoreceptor, chemoreceptor). 14. Neuromuscular transmission (skeletal muscle, smooth muscle, cardiac muscle, acetylcholine receptor). 15. Regulation of motor system (motor reflex, locomotion). 16. Evolution of behavior (instinctive behavior, fixed action pattern, releaser, key stimulus).
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of chemistry, physics, and math are required. In order to understand the information presented, the habit of studying the background information is required.

activityGoals.body: Explain information processing by the nervous system.
Explain the behavior of animals and humans as a function of nerves and brain.
Explain the function of the nervous system from an evolutionary perspective.
